source.title_or_context: With HFrEF, four types of medications are essential. You may hear your health care team refer to these as the “four pillars of heart failure medication” or “guideline-directed medical therapy.” These medicines have been proven to help patients feel their best, avoid going to the hospital and live longer. Heart failure is a leading cause of hospitalization among people 65 and older.
